title: FreshEpistemic10 natural-revision unit construction and pre-prediction gold order
scientific_reason: The Fresh charter prospectively fixes selection of agent-facing registration surfaces but the inherited Gate2E challenge assumed pre-existing before/after heldout units and does not define how an arbitrary fresh surface becomes a consequence-preservation unit. Opening source without fixing that construction would permit post-exposure benchmark design. This protocol closes that gap while target-source exposure remains exactly zero.

unit_selection.rule: Use the exact repository eligible_rank_order and exact immutable HEAD SHAs already sealed by the metadata authority. Run the exact frozen opaque structural extractor. Within each repository sort by unit_rank_sha256 then opaque_unit_locator, take at most two, and continue repository rank order until the first exact ten. No source-content, language-support, historical-diff, execution-support, gold, or expected-prediction filter may influence inclusion.

natural_revision_construction.principle: Each selected surface is tested on a real repository revision transition that produced the exact HEAD file bytes containing that surface; no synthetic mutation is introduced.
natural_revision_construction.after_file: The exact private_relative_path emitted by the frozen extractor at immutable_head_sha; its bytes and SHA-256 must equal the extractor content_sha256.

algorithm: Let A be the Git blob identity of path at immutable_head_sha.
Starting at immutable_head_sha, walk first parents only, counting at most 1024 parent edges.
Find the nearest commit C on that chain such that blob(path,C)=A, C has first parent P, and blob(path,P) is different from A or path is absent at P.
Set change_commit=C and before_revision=P. after bytes remain the exact HEAD bytes A, not bytes from a moving branch tip.
If no such C/P exists within the fixed bound, construction_status=HISTORY_PAIR_UNRESOLVED.
history_walk.merge_rule: Never follow a non-first parent and never choose among merge parents after source inspection.
history_walk.rename_rule: No rename-following heuristic. The exact selected path is authoritative; absence at P is explicit rather than repaired by similarity or rename search.

surface_continuity.requirement: A comparison can be semantically definitive only if an independently frozen structural continuity check establishes a role-compatible agent-facing surface in before bytes without semantic-interest search.
surface_continuity.continuity_key: private_kind plus private_form plus deterministic ordinal among extractor hits of the same kind/form in the exact path, where the after ordinal is computed by source order; the before candidate is the same ordinal among exact frozen-extractor hits of the same kind/form on before bytes.

conditions: both byte sets are UTF-8 and within frozen extractor file-size bound
READY.meaning: Eligible for frozen RISU/baseline/ablation execution subject to each method's preregistered support predicate.

CONSTRUCTION_SUPPORT_INCOMPLETE.meaning: The sealed unit remains one of the ten. RISU must emit INCOMPLETE with explicit prospective support reason; applicable baselines follow their own frozen predicates. Never replace the unit.

conditions: no qualifying first-parent transition within 1024 edges
history object unavailable after exact-revision transport retries are exhausted
HISTORY_PAIR_UNRESOLVED.meaning: The sealed unit remains one of the ten and is INCOMPLETE unless the inherited evaluator classifies the condition as infrastructure invalidity. No replacement, path search, bound increase, second-parent walk, or heuristic repair is allowed.

comparison_scope.scientific_question: For the selected agent-facing registration surface, does the real revision transition from before_revision to the sealed exact-HEAD after bytes preserve the claim-relevant observable consequence under the pre-existing RISU E2 semantic support contract?
comparison_scope.addition_or_discontinuous_surface: TRUTH_EPISTEMICALLY_INSUFFICIENT unless the independently frozen gold procedure can establish a valid comparable pre-state under this exact continuity rule; absence alone is never coerced to regression.

gold_order_amendment.supersedes: Only the temporal gold-authoring clause of f3b944b7a7cd2dfdf993e96b8e048abac1fc0925. All independence, no-prediction-access, disagreement, unresolved, immutability, and fail-closed requirements remain binding.
gold_order_amendment.reason: Gate2D constitution 10a02b7d519b885ab038d9b06b50eb7e23862d88 requires admissible gold identity to pre-exist prediction execution. The earlier post-pretruth authoring order would conflict with that inherited requirement.
fixed_order: Machine-only exact target staging, frozen extraction, exact-ten selection, natural-revision pair construction, and pair sealing. No RISU/baseline/ablation semantic execution and no prediction yet.

Independent gold lane receives only sealed pair bytes plus opaque unit identity and this prospectively frozen question. It receives no RISU/baseline/ablation output, certificate, metric, support decision, or expected prediction because none may exist yet.
Independent gold author and independent gold checker each produce canonical outputs. Definitive disagreement becomes GOLD_DISAGREEMENT; uncertainty becomes GOLD_UNRESOLVED. No tie-break or repair.
Freeze and content-address the complete gold bundle and its admissibility receipt.
Close all gold paths from the machine execution workspace and verify gold_read_count=0 there.
Only then execute RISU, preregistered applicable baselines, preregistered ablations, and independent pretruth checkers; freeze all machine outputs.
Join only the already-frozen gold bundle to the already-frozen machine-output bundle; run inherited evaluator and independent evaluator checker twice and require logical byte identity.

method_support.full_system: No semantic kernel, C1 authority, adapter, projection, binding, generic normalization, Go/TypeScript expansion, or support profile may be widened for this challenge after this freeze. Unsupported or unconstructable inputs remain INCOMPLETE with explicit reason.
method_support.baselines: Use the exact frozen Gate2D baseline registry and its baseline-specific applicability predicates. INAPPLICABLE is baseline-specific and never removes a unit from RISU's denominator.
method_support.ablations: Use the exact frozen Gate2D ablation registry. No ablation may mutate the primary result.

irreversibility.source_exposure_then_failure: Preserve first-complete failure or incomplete outcome. Do not repair and rerun the same sealed ten as a new clean heldout claim.

natural_revision_construction.next_authorized_action: Implement the exact network stager, natural-history constructor, isolation boundaries, full scientific workflow, and zero-exposure ARM in a single final implementation commit; run zero-exposure ARM on that exact commit before any target source staging.
